feed.text: Northbridge FC open talks with Riverside FC to sign Leo Silva before the window closes.
Eastgate United bid 42.5M for Leo Silva.
Transfer fee agreed between Riverside FC and Northbridge FC: 39.5M plus up to 12M in add-ons.

The window closes. Leo Silva joins Eastgate United instead, for 42.5M, because Northbridge FC could not agree personal terms (Northbridge's last offer was 6.3M a year on a 5-year contract, the demand was 7.8M a year on a 4-year contract).

picture.headline: Hijacked
picture.note: Northbridge FC could not agree personal terms (Northbridge's last offer was 6.3M a year on a 5-year contract, the demand was 7.8M a year on a 4-year contract) in time, so Riverside FC accepted Eastgate United's bid of 42.5M.
